proof_body:
by
  intro f c r hr hd hm
  by_contra hnd
  rw [dense_iff_closure_eq] at hnd
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, a ∉ closure (f '' (Metric.ball c r \ {c})) := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    exact hnd (Set.eq_univ_of_forall h)
  rw [Metric.mem_closure_iff] at ha
  push_neg at ha
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hfar⟩ := ha
  have hfar' : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball c r \ {c}, ε ≤ ‖f z - a‖ := fun z hz => by
    have := hfar (f z) ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    rwa [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm] at this
  have hne : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball c r \ {c}, f z - a ≠ 0 := fun z hz h => by
    have := hfar' z hz
    rw [h, norm_zero] at this
    linarith
  have hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => (f z - a)⁻¹) (Metric.ball c r \ {c}) := (hd.sub_const a).inv hne
  have hb : BddAbove (norm ∘ (fun z => (f z - a)⁻¹) '' (Metric.ball c r \ {c})) := by
    refine ⟨ε⁻¹, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, norm_inv]
    exact inv_anti₀ hε (hfar' z hz)
  have hs : Metric.ball c r ∈ nhds c := Metric.ball_mem_nhds c hr
  have hG := Complex.differentiableOn_update_limUnder_of_bddAbove hs hg hb
  obtain ⟨G, hGd, hGe⟩ : ∃ G : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ G (Metric.ball c r) ∧ ∀ z, z ≠ c → G z = (f z - a)⁻¹ :=
    ⟨_, hG, fun z hz => Function.update_of_ne hz _ _⟩
  have hGa : AnalyticAt ℂ G c := hGd.analyticAt hs
  apply hm
  have h1 : MeromorphicAt (fun z => a + (G z)⁻¹) c := (MeromorphicAt.const a c).add hGa.meromorphicAt.inv
  refine h1.congr ?_
  have hev : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin c {c}ᶜ, z ∈ Metric.ball c r \ {c} := by
    filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds hs, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with z h1 h2
    exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
  filter_upwards [hev] with z hz
  have : G z = (f z - a)⁻¹ := hGe z hz.2
  simp [this]
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball c r \ {c}) → ¬ MeromorphicAt f c → Dense (f '' (Metric.ball c r \ {c}))
